specs.label: Type
specs.tip: The body type.

specs.label: Lens mount
specs.tip: The lens mount on the body.

specs.label: Sensor size
specs.tip: The sensor format, and its width and height in mm where the page states them.

specs.label: Sensor resolution
specs.tip: Effective megapixels (not total or "actual" pixels).

specs.label: In-body stabilization
specs.tip: Whether the sensor is stabilized in the body (sensor-shift / IBIS). Electronic or digital stabilization for video only is false. The stops rating, if stated, goes in "note".

specs.label: Initial release date
specs.tip: The day the maker announced the camera (its press release date). Not an on-sale or shipping date.

specs.label: Initial release MSRP
specs.tip: The US launch price of the body alone, in US dollars, as announced.

specs.label: Current new price
specs.tip: This retailer's current price for the body alone, new, in US dollars.

specs.label: Current used price
specs.tip: This seller's current price for a used body alone, in US dollars.

specs.label: AF points
specs.tip: The most AF positions or points that can be selected for stills, as the maker counts them ("AF positions", "focus points", "AF points"). Not automatic AF zones, not video positions, not cross-type counts: put those in "note".

specs.label: Display size
specs.tip: The rear screen diagonal.

specs.label: Display resolution
specs.tip: The rear screen resolution in dots.

specs.label: Display articulation
specs.tip: How the rear screen moves: Fully articulated (side-hinged, vari-angle, flip-out), Tilting (up/down only), Multi-angle (tilts and flips, e.g. 4-axis or tilt-and-free-angle), or Fixed.

specs.label: Touchscreen
specs.tip: Whether the rear screen is a touchscreen.

specs.label: Viewfinder
specs.tip: A built-in viewfinder. An optional, attachable accessory viewfinder is "None".

specs.label: Viewfinder resolution
specs.tip: The built-in viewfinder resolution in dots (never an optional accessory viewfinder).

specs.label: Viewfinder magnification
specs.tip: Built-in viewfinder magnification (with a 50 mm lens at infinity, 35 mm equivalent).

specs.label: Battery type
specs.tip: The battery's model code.

specs.label: Battery life (CIPA)
specs.tip: CIPA-rated shots per charge using the rear screen (LCD), as the maker's spec sheet publishes it (not a viewfinder figure). Other modes go in "note".

specs.label: Weight
specs.tip: Weight with battery and memory card (CIPA).

specs.label: Weight (body only)
specs.tip: Weight of the body alone, without battery or card.

specs.label: Dimensions
specs.tip: Width × height × depth of the body.

specs.label: Weatherproofing
specs.tip: Whether the body is dust- and moisture-resistant (weather-sealed). "Waterproof: No" says nothing about sealing.

specs.label: Max ISO (native)
specs.tip: The highest native (standard, not expanded) ISO for stills.

specs.label: Max ISO (with expansion)
specs.tip: The highest ISO selectable for stills, expanded/extended/boosted settings included. When the camera has no expanded range above its native maximum, that maximum.

specs.label: Max still resolution
specs.tip: The largest still image size in pixels (width × height), from the sensor (not pixel-shift composites).

specs.label: Fastest shutter (mechanical)
specs.tip: The fastest speed of the mechanical shutter (or mechanical with electronic first curtain). "None" when the camera has no mechanical shutter.

specs.label: Fastest shutter (electronic)
specs.tip: The fastest speed of the fully electronic shutter, for stills. Never an electronic front-curtain figure.

specs.label: Slowest shutter
specs.tip: The slowest timed shutter speed (not bulb or time limits).

specs.label: Max burst
specs.tip: The fastest continuous shooting at full resolution, any shutter (pre-capture included if at full resolution).

specs.label: RAW bit depth
specs.tip: The bit depth of still RAW files (not video).

specs.label: Still file formats
specs.tip: Still image file formats it records.

specs.label: Movie capture formats
specs.tip: Each internal recording frame size with its frame rates (not HDMI output, streaming or proxy sizes). Rates as stated (23.98, 59.94 are fine).

specs.label: Max movie resolution
specs.tip: Derived: the largest agreed frame size at its fastest agreed rate.

specs.label: Recording formats
specs.tip: Internal video codecs (not containers such as MP4 or MOV, not compression modes such as Long GOP or All-Intra, not codecs only available over HDMI to an external recorder).

specs.label: Video bit depth
specs.tip: The highest internal video bit depth (RAW video included).

specs.label: Card slots
specs.tip: One entry per card slot, each with every card type it takes.

specs.label: Wi-Fi
specs.tip: Built-in Wi-Fi and its standard (802.11ax = Wi-Fi 6, ac = Wi-Fi 5, n = Wi-Fi 4). "Yes" when present but the standard is not stated; "No" when stated absent.

specs.label: Bluetooth
specs.tip: Built-in Bluetooth and its version; "Yes" when the version is not stated; "No" when stated absent.

specs.label: GPS (built-in)
specs.tip: Whether a GPS receiver is built in. Location from a connected phone app is false.

specs.label: Ports
specs.tip: Physical connectors on the body.

specs.label: UVC/UAC webcam
specs.tip: Whether it works as a standard USB webcam (UVC/UAC) without extra software.

specs.label: UVC/UAC max resolution
specs.tip: The best frame size and rate it streams as a USB webcam.

method.sources: Every camera body B&H lists new, newest first. Each is looked up on the maker's own site and press release, B&H, DPReview, Adorama, Crutchfield, Wex, launch news, Wikipedia, MPB and eBay, and every page is kept as it was read.
method.reading: Agents read each page against one dictionary of about 45 specs, quoting the words that state each value; a reading is kept only when its quote is on the page and its figures match.
method.verification: A value is verified when independent sources (different owners: two sites of one company count once) agree; disagreements are adjudicated against each spec's definition.
method.level: A 0–100 spec level from fixed scales per area (resolution, video, burst, viewfinder, stabilization, card slots, build and battery, autofocus, screen), weighted, with a reason per area.
